a.speaker: Saturday, October 9
a.text:
The wind comes up the valley at three in the afternoon and doesn't stop. By five the transformers on Baseline are popping blue one after another. The court goes dark.

It's a dress rehearsal nobody scheduled.

Then {teen.name} shouts from the hall: {child.name} went out the back after {dog.name} when the lights died. Neither of them came back.

options.text: Grab a light and go find them.
